exclusions.source_text: Performance status of 0 or 1 on Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) scale
History of a previous additional malignancy, unless potentially curative treatment has been completed, with no evidence of malignancy for 2 years.
exclusions.threshold: no evidence of malignancy for 2 years

exclusions.source_text: Active known CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis from a systemic (non-CNS) primary malignancy.
